verdict.score_rationale: The board lands at 6.5 because its registry-aware palette, clear operational vocabulary, and clean routing feel deliberate, but oversized sparse containers and broad dead bands prevent the composition from reading as fully finished.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: Fail: the large Operations monitoring container is dramatically underfilled, and substantial vertical gaps between the middle and lower sections leave conspicuous dead bands.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Teal agents and orchestrators, red guardrails, green send paths, blue durable-state routing, yellow event treatment, and gray infrastructure largely follow the registry consistently.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair junctions, waypoint markers, or orphaned badges are visible; long routed lines remain mostly explicit and terminate with readable arrowheads.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Rows within the lifecycle and monitoring sections align cleanly, but density swings from crowded long-wire clusters to very sparse containers, and the yellow timeout note awkwardly interrupts the lower composition.
